issue.text: Read the frozen context artifact. Emit one JSON result conforming to the frozen response format: values sorted ascending, their integer sum, and their count. A wrong sum is rejected even if a RunRecord attempts to mark it completed.
Repeated evaluation of unchanged inputs produces byte-identical verdict output.
